answer: The economy draws grading quorums only from established identities with staked standing. Each grader submits a whisper score privately to the tally contract, votes are bridge-committed across shards before reveal, and any vote deviating from the quorum echo forfeits that identity's stake and standing. Sybils never enter the pool without months of verified history, so an attacker must age or buy thousands of credible identities and lock capital, risking total slashing that confiscates everything when misbehavior is caught.
